comment: EPO03 accepted atlas regions for team landmarks, in blit order. A region appears here ONLY after the single-defect loop ACCEPT (generate -> composite -> guards -> full atlas + x2 perimeter + 197x426 phone FOV -> verdict). Fields: id, x, y, w, h (crop origin/size on the 1024^2 atlas; <id>.png and <id>_mask.png are exactly w x h), salt (>= 40, unique across all five manifests), status, job, seed, atlas, review, team, reauthorizes (landmark golden ids this region overwrites; each is re-extracted in the same commit — DECISIONS/0033).

regions.name: ice_bastion
regions.intent: The Ice-Mage Tower rebuilt on a glacial foundation: an organic ice mound with blue south faces, a tall crystal spire with a dark gate, a pillared causeway winding up from the south-west (r3; r1 ziggurat rejected, r2 held).

regions.name: storm_pocket
regions.intent: The Storm House painted into the heath: a gloom hollow with a black-gabled house 34 px wide, three amber windows, blasted leaning trees (one split and charred), a wet track with puddles. Cut from the composite after SOUTH S2; r2 (a whole-rect shadow) rejected as a generated rectangle.

regions.name: fairy_glade
regions.intent: The Fairy Castle painted into the core canopy: a glade with a moss-green pool ringed in gold flower-light, a pale root bridge across it, a castle grown from three birch trunks with amber windows at (335,452), winding paths. r1 (no pool, a dry ravine) rejected.
